label: consent_choice
title: Sharing choice
body: The native sharing choice reads Ask each time until the saved include-existing grant is read back. Choosing Automatic opens its disclosures; the pending choice does not arm a folder. The detailed durable policy and queue records appear in the explanatory internal panel.

label: consent_request
title: Automatic disclosures
body: The existing disclosures and witness identity are shown before confirmation. This frame groups the two disclosures and optional keep-folder-Ask question; it is an explanatory projection, not an added application screen.

label: consent_saving
title: Recording consent
body: Internal stages: validate confirmed choice, scopes and shown witness; append audit; save the fresh grant with rollback on policy-save failure; return the response. The displayed sharing choice remains separate from the durable grant.

label: consent_internal
title: Consent and queue records
body: Internal explanatory panel: two folders and two entries have independent origins, generation-bound Ask exceptions, captured source-list identities, from-now snapshots and terms validity. Policy changes retract queued automatic approvals; manual approvals and in-flight rows have separate rules. The controls below select abstract inputs and do not propose product UI.
